author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read Compliance Logs Platform records from ChatGPT Enterprise and Edu workspaces. The bridge in bridges/ai-compliance-logs pulls them from the Admin API and sends each record as one JSON object to HTTP Ingest. AUTH_LOG goes to Auth, AUDIT_LOG to ManagementEvent and CONVERSATION_MESSAGE to CloudAudit.
notes:
Setup:
- The Compliance Logs Platform is pull only (the Admin API lists and serves JSONL files), so records need a bridge to reach Sophos NG-SIEM.
- Send each record as one JSON object to an HTTP Ingest integration (Security Operations > Integrations > Marketplace > Custom in Sophos Fusion).
- bridges/ai-compliance-logs in this repo does that.

Field mapping:
- AUTH_LOG goes to Auth, AUDIT_LOG to ManagementEvent and CONVERSATION_MESSAGE to CloudAudit; APP_LOG, CODEX_LOG and the other log types stay in generic.
- Privacy: CONVERSATION_MESSAGE records carry prompts and responses.
- The parsers map metadata only (user, model, client, conversation, message, GPT and Project IDs, file count).
- Message text, quotes, custom instructions, titles, file names and GPT or Project names never go into a normalized field, and AUDIT_LOG action_data, which can hold system instructions, isn't mapped.
- original_data keeps what the bridge sends, so the bridge redacts content by default.
- ManagementEvent has no address field, so the client IP is in host_id, and action_privilege (ADMIN or STANDARD_USER) is in operation.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are synthetic, built from the record shapes in OpenAI's Admin API reference.

Testing:
- Each parser passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13: 182 of 182 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs, no parser claimed another's lines, and no built-in parser claimed any line.

Known gaps:
- No live workspace was available, so the parsers are tested against the documented shapes only.
